plain: A clever plan to outwit an enemy

webster.text: An artifice, particularly in war; a plan or scheme for deceiving an enemy.

example.quote: Nor ought it to be doubted, that the stratagem will readily occur to every government that can with impunity and without animadversion, indulge that "unlimited passion," which the frankness of our President has declared to be an attribute of human nature.
example.cite: James Madison, Political Reflections, Aurora General Advertiser, Feb. 23, 1799
